why: UHTRUST is a named, reusable authentic performance assessment instrument rather than a general instructional element.
name: UHTRUST: Utrecht Hamburg Trainee Responsibility for Unfamiliar Situation Test
product_description: UHTRUST is a multilingual authentic performance assessment developed collaboratively by Utrecht and Hamburg to assess near-graduate medical students' readiness for clinical practice and entrustment-relevant competence in unfamiliar situations.
